new_files.summary: Data Provider API v1 barrel. Aggregates 9 sub-routers (laws, procedures, commissioners, consultations, legal-text, publications, docs, meta, meta_enums) under /api/v1 prefix.
Search 28,500+ adopted EU laws via TSVECTOR full-text search. Filters by CELEX, doc_type, policy_area, date range.
Search 1,200+ legislative procedures (carriages). Filters by OEIL reference, committee, status, rapporteur, date range.
EC Have Your Say consultation feedback. Wraps HaveYourSayFeedbackClient with PaginatedResponse envelope and aggregates (by_user_type, by_country).
Live Commissioner College agenda scraper. Resolves name accent-insensitively, queries commission.europa.eu calendar.
Legal-text intelligence endpoints: recital-article map, defined terms, cross-reference resolution, text annotation. Wraps internal parsers for paid API surface.
Unified EU institutional publications feed from 78+ RSS sources. Filters by institution, source, category, policy area, full-text search, date range.
Scalar-powered API reference documentation. Filters OpenAPI spec to /api/v1/* paths only. Serves rendered HTML with Scalar CDN viewer.
Health check (ping, unauthenticated) and whoami (authenticated, shows tier + rate limit remaining).
Returns all valid enum values for every v1 filter (doc_types, policy_areas, EP committees, procedure statuses, stakeholder types). Partners call once and cache.
Shared FastAPI dependency for v1: API key auth + 60 req/min sliding window rate limit per key.
Canonical PaginatedResponse envelope for all v1 endpoints. GovClipping-compatible shape with pagination metadata, date ranges, detail level.
Canonical error envelope + X-Request-Id middleware for v1. Wraps all 4xx/5xx into {error, reason_code, request_id} shape.
API key authentication dependency for /api/v1/*. Extracts X-API-Key or Bearer header, SHA-256 lookup, blue-tier gate, background last_used update.
Admin API key management: mint (plaintext shown once), list, and revoke API keys for Professional subscribers.
WhatsApp Cloud API webhook: Meta verification handshake (GET) and inbound message handler (POST) with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and sender allowlist.
Position Analysis API: full position snapshot, article-by-article drilldown, user stance CRUD, force-refresh (Blue tier), list tracked positions.
SQLAlchemy model for API keys. Format: brubru_live_ + 48 hex chars. Only SHA-256 hash persisted. key_prefix for admin display.
FilePositionSnapshot model: cached aggregate Commission/Parliament/Council positions per legislative carriage. 24h TTL. JSONB columns for each institution block.
InstitutionalPublication model: unified shape for all RSS-ingested items from 78+ EU feeds. Fields: source_slug, institution_slug, category, policy_areas, tags.
CommitteeMeetingTranscript model: AI-transcribed EP committee meetings from EP Multimedia Centre. Stores segments, speakers, agenda mapping, procedure refs. Transcription via Whisper API.
Position Analysis service barrel: exports PositionAggregator, get_position_aggregator, FilePosition, GroupPosition, MemberStatePosition.

PositionAggregator: assembles file-level position snapshots combining Commission docs, EP group vote predictions (GroupVotePredictor), Council member state inference (CouncilPositionInferrer), and amendment activity. 592 lines, complex.

WhatsApp command dispatcher: /morning, /news, /daily-brief, /send, /status, /skip, /help. Safety: send actions require explicit confirmation. Background subprocess for heavy work. In-memory pending state.
WhatsApp Cloud API outbound helper: sends text messages via Meta Graph API with automatic chunking at 4000 chars. Uses httpx async.
Full transcription pipeline: EP multimedia video -> ffmpeg audio extraction -> OpenAI Whisper API -> agenda mapping -> DB storage. Cost: $0.006/min (~$0.72/2h meeting).
EP Multimedia Centre scraper: discovers committee meeting recordings from multimedia.europarl.europa.eu. Extracts video URLs, agenda items, meeting metadata.
Have Your Say Feedback Client: fetches stakeholder feedback contributions via EC Better Regulation API (allFeedback endpoint). Paginated, with in-memory cache (6h TTL).
Commissioner agenda scraper: discovers per-commissioner political-leader ID from bio page, queries faceted calendar from commission.europa.eu. Accent-insensitive name resolution for all 27 members.
Generic RSS ingestion package init.
Generic RSS/Atom ingester: reads YAML configs (78 files), fetches each feed, normalises entries into institutional_publications table. Config-driven, no per-feed Python code needed.
Legislative tracking service: monitors CELEX legislation status, OEIL procedure progress, related amendments. Uses OEILScraper and ContentAnalyzer.
CLI script to batch-populate file_position_snapshots for all carriages with OEIL refs + amendments/docs/events. Supports --limit, --only, --force flags.
Feed discovery crawler: probes 519 europa.eu domains for RSS/Atom feeds via HTML link tags and common paths. Outputs validated catalog to discovered_feeds.csv.
Converts discovered_feeds.csv into YAML ingestion configs for the generic RSS ingester. One YAML per feed, skips existing configs.
CLI to run the generic RSS ingester: all configs or a named subset.
Batch Catalan translation pipeline: processes queue file, translates acts sequentially, audits, imports to DB, deploys to SiteGround. Supports --count, --max-size, --dry-run.
Quality evaluation suite: runs 30 golden answer queries against backend, scores on 7 criteria (CELEX refs, British English, no deflection, etc.), reports aggregate Brubru Quality Score (BQS).

MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Brubru's knowledge base and DB as tools: ask_brubru, search_eu_legislation, search_knowledge_guides, get_procedure_status, get_calendar_events, search_eprs.

new_findings.title: Data Provider API v1 is the largest addition since last audit
new_findings.details: A complete public paid API surface with 15 endpoints across 9 sub-routers: laws (28.5K), procedures (1.2K), consultations (feedback), commissioners (live agenda), legal-text (4 intelligence endpoints), publications (78 feeds), docs, meta, enums. Authenticated via X-API-Key (SHA-256 hashed, Professional tier only). Rate-limited at 60 req/min per key with sliding window. Canonical PaginatedResponse envelope mimics GovClipping format. Error envelope includes reason_code and X-Request-Id.
new_findings.recommendation: Well-architected. Good test coverage (7 test files). Consider adding Redis backing for rate limiter if running multi-instance.

new_findings.title: WhatsApp Cloud API integration added
new_findings.details: 3 new files: api/whatsapp.py (webhook), services/whatsapp_router.py (command dispatcher), services/whatsapp_send.py (outbound). Commands: /morning, /news, /daily-brief, /send, /status, /skip, /help. Safety: send actions require explicit confirmation. In-memory pending state (single-instance only). 12h rate limit on /morning.
new_findings.recommendation: Good safety design. Note: in-memory state is lost on Railway restart. Consider DB-backed pending state if this becomes critical.

new_findings.title: Position Analysis feature added
new_findings.details: New model (file_position_snapshots), service (position_aggregator.py, 592 lines), and API (5 endpoints). Aggregates Commission/Parliament/Council positions using existing GroupVotePredictor and CouncilPositionInferrer. 24h snapshot TTL. User can save their own stance. Article-by-article drill-down from mep_amendments.
new_findings.recommendation: Complex service but well-structured. The singleton pattern with optional DB session injection is appropriate.

new_findings.title: Committee Meeting Transcription infrastructure added
new_findings.details: New model (committee_meeting_transcripts), service (committee_transcription_service.py), and client (ep_multimedia_client.py). Pipeline: discover meeting -> ffmpeg audio -> Whisper API -> agenda mapping. Cost: ~$0.72 per 2h meeting.
new_findings.recommendation: Model and service exist but no API endpoint or CLI script to trigger transcription was found. May be incomplete or awaiting frontend integration.

new_findings.title: Generic RSS ingestion pipeline added (Data Provider infrastructure)
new_findings.details: 78 YAML feed configs in services/ingestion/configs/. Generic rss_ingestor.py reads any config and populates institutional_publications table. CLI via scripts/ingest_publications.py. Feeds discovered via scripts/discover_feeds.py from 519 europa.eu domains.
new_findings.recommendation: Impressive scale. Consider a cron job or scheduler for periodic ingestion.

new_findings.title: MCP Server added
new_findings.details: backend/mcp_server.py exposes 6 tools via Model Context Protocol: ask_brubru, search_eu_legislation, search_knowledge_guides, get_procedure_status, get_calendar_events, search_eprs. Allows any MCP-compatible AI to use Brubru as a tool.
new_findings.recommendation: Good MCP integration. Ensure the server is properly secured in production.

new_findings.title: Quality evaluation suite added
new_findings.details: scripts/eval_quality.py runs 30 golden answer queries against the live backend and scores on 7 criteria. Produces aggregate Brubru Quality Score (BQS).
new_findings.recommendation: Excellent quality infrastructure. Run regularly as part of CI or morning routine.

new_findings.title: WhatsApp router executes /send via subprocess without explicit --extra flags
new_findings.details: In _send_daily_brief(), the script runs 'scripts/send_daily_brief.py --send' without --extra or --extra-file. This means it sends only to default subscribers. The CLAUDE.md protocol requires --verify-urls first, but the WhatsApp router skips URL verification.
new_findings.recommendation: Add --verify-urls to the subprocess call, or implement URL verification in the WhatsApp flow before allowing send.

new_findings.title: WhatsApp chat route bypasses authentication
new_findings.details: In whatsapp_router.py _cmd_chat(), the POST to /api/chat/message uses user_id=None, meaning the chat runs as an unauthenticated user. This may limit context or features available.
new_findings.recommendation: Consider mapping WhatsApp sender to a user account for authenticated chat.

new_findings.title: api/v1/_errors.py registers global exception handlers
new_findings.details: register_v1_error_handlers() registers exception handlers on the entire app, then filters by path prefix (/api/v1/). This works but means every non-v1 exception also goes through these handlers (with a fast-path return). A cleaner approach would be sub-application mounting.
new_findings.recommendation: Low priority. Current approach works correctly; just slightly inelegant.

new_findings.title: 3 new DB tables added
new_findings.details: api_keys (API key management), file_position_snapshots (cached position analysis), institutional_publications (unified RSS feed items), committee_meeting_transcripts (EP committee transcripts).
new_findings.recommendation: Ensure Alembic migrations exist for all 4 tables.
